name: anomx-editor-context
description: Writes the active file, cursor, selection and visible lines to a local JSON file so the Anomx CLI agent knows what you are looking at.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Writes editor state to a file outside the workspace.

anomxEditorContext.path.description: Override the output path. Default: $ANOMX_HOME/editor-context.json or ~/.anomx/editor-context.json.
